title: Data Analytics Quality Assurance Engineer

description: Role Summary The Technical Antenna is the company's technical reference for the Schneider Electric BlokSeT LV switchboard system. The role makes sure every BlokSeT panel we design and build follows the BlokSeT LV standard. It is also the main technical contact with Schneider’s Partner Support (PSP) team. The Technical Antenna maintains the BlokSeT technical transfer file, checks quality, trains internal teams, and supports the design, tendering and estimation teams on BlokSeT technical questions. Key Responsibilities 1. BlokSeT LV Standard Compliance Control and ensure that every BlokSeT switchboard is designed, assembled and tested according to the BlokSeT LV standard and Schneider guidelines. Check designs and panel layouts against BlokSeT configuration rules and IEC 61439 requirements. Flag any deviation from the standard and drive corrective action with the design and production teams. 2. Communication with Schneider PSP Act as the single point of contact with the Schneider Electric PSP team for local adaptation and design queries. Raise technical queries, get clarifications and approvals for non-standard or locally adapted solutions, and track them to closure. Keep up to date with Schneider technical updates, new references and changes to the BlokSeT system. 3. BlokSeT Technical Transfer File Maintain the BlokSeT technical transfer file – technical manuals, assembly instructions, configuration guides and updates. Make sure the design, production and QA teams always use the latest approved revision of each document. Keep records of local adaptations, Schneider approvals and technical correspondence ready for audit. 4. BlokSeT Quality Control Carry out quality checks on BlokSeT panels during assembly and before dispatch, against BlokSeT checklists. Support routine testing and verification and make sure test records are complete. Support Schneider audits and close any non-conformities that are raised. 5. Internal Team Training Train design, production, QA and project teams on the BlokSeT system, assembly rules and quality requirements. Prepare simple training material and keep a record of training given. 6. Support to Design Team Guide the design team on BlokSeT technical aspects – configuration, busbar systems, functional units and form of separation. Review GA drawings and BOMs for BlokSeT panels for technical correctness. 7. Support to Tendering Estimation Read and analyse RFQ documents and technical specifications, and identify BlokSeT-related requirements. Help the tendering and estimation team with BlokSeT technical details, compliance statements and the right configuration. Get Schneider support on technical clarifications needed during tendering. Required Qualifications B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in in Electrical or Electrical Electronics Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Fresher or up to 1 year of experience in LV switchboards / panel design (BlokSeT exposure is an advantage). Basic understanding of LV switchgear – ACBs, MCCBs, busbars, protection and form of separation. Basic knowledge of IEC 61439 is an advantage. Ability to read electrical drawings (SLDs, GA drawings); basic AutoCAD knowledge is a plus. Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Key Skills Documentation Reading: Read and understand technical documents, manuals and standards. Technical Analysis: Review and analyse technical requirements of RFQs and specifications. Strong Communication: Clear, confident spoken and written English to deal with Schneider and internal teams. Documentation: Organised and accurate record-keeping and document control. Learning Attitude: Eager to learn and become the in-house BlokSeT expert. Key Performance Indicators All BlokSeT panels compliant with the BlokSeT LV standard. Schneider PSP queries raised and closed on time. Technical transfer file kept complete and up to date. Zero major non-conformities in Schneider audits. Number of internal training sessions delivered. Timely technical support to design and tendering teams.

title: Software Engineer III- ServiceNow QA Analyst
description: JOB DESCRIPTION We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level. As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile delivery team to validate and assure market-leading ServiceNow solutions in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for executing and improving testing practices across ServiceNow applications and workflows, ensuring releases meet functional, integration, performance, and control requirements in support of the firm's business objectives. Job responsibilities Execute QA activities including test planning, test case creation, test execution, defect triage, and test reporting for ServiceNow releases (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps as applicable). Design and maintain the scalable manual and automated regression and performance test suites for ServiceNow configurations and customizations (workflows/Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, integrations, portals). Perform functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end testing across ServiceNow and upstream/downstream systems (APIs, MID Server, SSO, CMDB-related integrations). Partner with developers, product owners, and platform teams to review requirements and acceptance criteria, identify test scenarios, and ensure appropriate coverage and traceability. Log, track, and manage defects with clear reproduction steps, severity/priority, and evidence; validate fixes and support release readiness decisions. Produce and maintain test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test data approach, RTM as needed) and contribute to release documentation and operational readiness. Analyze testing results and trends to identify recurring defects, root causes, and quality risks, recommending improvements to process, controls, and platform hygiene. Support CI/CD quality gates by integrating testing into pipelines where applicable and promoting consistent QA standards across environments (DEV/TEST/UAT/PROD). Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness. Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience Hands-on practical experience in QA/testing within the Software Development Life Cycle, including test design, execution, defect management, and release validation. Experience testing ServiceNow configurations/customizations and understanding of core platform components (tables, forms, lists, ACLs, notifications, workflows/Flow Designer). Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and QA in iterative release cycles; familiarity with CI/CD concepts and environment promotion practices. Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow Agile Development, or similar). Basic understanding of web technologies and APIs (HTTP, REST, JSON) and ability to validate integrations using logs and test tools (e.g., Postman or equivalent). Ability to create clear, actionable documentation and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Understanding of security and controls concepts relevant to testing (e.g., access controls/roles, data handling, auditability, evidence capture). Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security. Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Experience with ServiceNow test automation (e.g., ATF – Automated Test Framework) and/or automation frameworks/tools used alongside ServiceNow. Familiarity with CMDB and ITIL-aligned processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset/Discovery). Exposure to performance testing concepts and non-functional testing (availability, resiliency, audit/compliance readiness). Experience validating SSO, LDAP, and multi-system integrations involving MID Server, integration hubs, or enterprise APIs. ABOUT US

description: Esko | Veralto Corporation Location: Bangalore, India | On-site Reports To: Senior Team Leader About The Role The Opportunity We’re seeking a self-driven Senior QA Specialist to strengthen quality engineering for WebCenter Enterprise, a Java/J2EE web application. In this hands-on role, you’ll independently own quality for assigned features and product areas, combining thoughtful manual testing with the creation and maintenance of reliable automated test scripts. You’ll work with the current SAHI-based automation suite and help evolve the framework, including evaluating Playwright or Selenium where appropriate. You’ll work closely with software engineers, product managers, and the Senior Team Leader to translate product and technical risks into an effective test approach. You’ll execute tests, interpret results, distinguish product defects from automation or environment failures, and communicate evidence-based quality risks. Success means meaningful automation coverage, effective exploratory testing, earlier defect detection, and dependable test results for WebCenter Enterprise. What You'll Do In this role, you will: Independently own the test approach for assigned features and product areas: assess customer and technical risk, clarify acceptance criteria, estimate effort, prioritize coverage, and raise dependencies or quality concerns early. Design and execute a balanced set of manual and automated tests, including exploratory, functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing; select the test layer and technique that best addresses the risk. Create, maintain, and improve reliable SAHI-based automated test scripts using established design patterns and reusable code; contribute to framework design and evaluate Playwright or Selenium where appropriate. Interpret test and CI/CD results, investigate failures systematically, and distinguish product defects from automation, test-data, or environment issues using logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence. Reduce flaky tests through root-cause analysis; maintain representative test data, repeatable setup and cleanup, dependable environments, and clear, actionable failure reporting. Collaborate with developers and product managers throughout the development lifecycle to improve testability, find defects earlier, and align testing with delivery timelines and product quality goals. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve QA processes, tooling, and feedback loops while protecting the stability of existing coverage. Produce concise, accurate test cases, automation code, defect reports, traceability, and quality summaries; communicate coverage, evidence, blockers, and release risks clearly to stakeholders. Share domain knowledge and practical QA and automation techniques with colleagues, and use approved AI tools responsibly where useful while independently validating outputs and protecting proprietary and customer data. Minimum Qualifications What We're Looking For These are the must-have requirements for the role: 8+ years of professional experience in software quality assurance, test automation, software development, or a combination thereof, including ownership of quality for complex web-product features. Strong hands-on ability in automated and manual testing, including writing, debugging, reviewing, and maintaining reusable automation code with established design patterns; practical programming or scripting skills in JavaScript, Java, or a comparable language; proficiency with Git, code review, and maintainable coding practices; and sound judgment in applying exploratory, functional, regression, and automated testing. Hands-on experience creating and maintaining web test automation with SAHI, Selenium, Playwright, or a comparable framework, together with the ability to become productive in SAHI. SAHI is the current automation tool; prior expertise in SAHI is not required. Hands-on experience designing, organizing, and implementing automated unit, integration, and API tests with Java frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent solutions, including parameterized or data-driven testing; API coverage should include HTTP/REST, authentication, response and schema validation, and negative scenarios using RestAssured or comparable code-based tools, with Postman or similar tools for exploratory testing. Experience integrating, maintaining, and diagnosing automated test execution in CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, including analysis of failures and reliable reporting of results. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including interpreting test results and investigating failures with logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence. Experience testing web and client/server products, preferably Java/J2EE enterprise applications, with a good understanding of browser behavior, sessions, authentication, authorization, and integrations. Strong risk-based test-design skills, including equivalence partitioning, boundary-value analysis, and state-transition testing. Ability to design representative test data, maintain repeatable setup and cleanup, and validate results and data integrity, including practical use of basic SQL queries where appropriate. Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams and contributing quality engineering and automation activities throughout iterative, sprint-based delivery. Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative working style, with the ability to explain quality risks, ask relevant questions, build consensus, and support less-experienced colleagues. Preferred Qualifications The following qualifications will help distinguish stronger candidates; relevant experience in one or more of these areas is valued: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. Relevant professional testing certification, such as ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL); advanced or specialist credentials—particularly ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE), Technical Test Analyst (CTAL-TTA), Quality in DevOps (CT-QDO), or an equivalent recognized certification are a differentiator for this senior automation-focused role. Practical experience using approved AI tools to accelerate test design, automation-code development, test-data generation, or failure analysis, with independent review and validation of outputs and appropriate protection of proprietary and customer data. Direct experience maintaining or evolving SAHI-based automation suites. Familiarity with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices and experience using Cucumber to translate expected user behaviors and acceptance criteria into clear, executable test scenarios and maintainable automated test scripts. Experience with performance testing and tools such as JMeter. Experience testing AI-assisted features with non-deterministic outputs, including correctness, consistency, reliability, and safe fallback behavior. Working knowledge of Jira and Atlassian Wiki, or comparable platforms, for defect management, test documentation, and collaboration.
